bloques.titulo: The scope limit is set: only the case indicated is included.
texto: As opposed to the number of people in the world, it restricts. In a notice, it locates whether the limit refers to date, place, quantity or person.
(Only for today, the entrance costs half.)
(This session is open only to those who have reserved.)

frases.ja: 本日 に かぎり、入場料 は 半額 です。
frases.es: Solo por hoy, la entrada cuesta la mitad.
frases.en: Only for today, the entrance costs half.

frases.ja: この 相談会 は 予約 した 方 に かぎり 参加 できます。
frases.es: A esta sesión solo pueden asistir quienes hayan reservado.
frases.en: Only those who have reserved may attend this session.
